name: Stronghold
description: The Stronghold was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier in service to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At some point, the cruiser-carrier sustained damage to its hull and lay in a debris field with two TIE/ln space superiority starfighters. The 340-meter-long (1,116 feet) starship was equipped with sublight engines and four hangar bays.
